newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen taking breather, opening mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen taking breather, opening mixed.

text.p: U.S. stocks should open mixed to slightly weaker Friday as the market pauses a bit after a strong week so far, marked by two new all-time high closings.
The Dow industrials thundered up 28 to about 6206 yesterday, a new all-time high, only day after striking into record territory on Wednesday in post-election euphoria.

"Based on indications, the Dow will probably open five to ten points lower and then gradually decline throughout the day although it should be met with some support," said Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Investments.
